connector.name: Datadog by us-all
connector.registryDescription: Datadog MCP - 165 tools for metrics, monitors, logs, APM, RUM, incidents, CI/CD, fleet
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package datadog-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the us-all account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DD_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated category allowlist (e.g. metrics,monitors,logs). Default: all categories enabled.

env.name: DD_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable write/destructive tools. Default read-only.
